_meta.purpose: Starter benchmark for Phase 3 baseline evaluation of candidate models on Nigerian tax law.
instructions: This is a STARTER set (25 questions) to get the pipeline running end-to-end, not the full 100.
Expand to 100 questions before final baseline results, pulling from your cleaned PITA/CITA/VAT/CGT/PPT/Stamp Duties corpus and the 2025 reform Acts (NTA, NTAA, NRSA, JRBA).

Every 'reference_answer' and 'citation' below is a DRAFT for pipeline testing only -- verify each against your Certified True Copies before treating it as ground truth. You already flagged authenticity concerns with circulating PDFs, so don't trust unverified reference answers here.
Categories match the doc's scoring table: legal_accuracy, citation, current_law, repealed_law, reasoning.
